title: A Mechanistic Interpretation of Prescribed-Parameter Convolutional Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2502.17061v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prescribed-parameter convolutional transforms achieve strong time series classification performance using fixed kernels, simple pooling operations, and a linear classifier. Their success raises a mechanistic question: which properties of the representation make this construction effective? We study the proportion of positive values (PPV), a pooling operator shared by ROCKET, MiniROCKET, and MultiROCKET. We establish exact invariance to circular translations under periodic boundaries and quantify departures from invariance under finite boundaries. A complementary analysis bounds the sensitivity of a smooth PPV surrogate. We then define the population pairwise geometry induced by a distribution of convolutional parameters and show how a finite random kernel bank concentrates around that geometry. This separates the role of the parameter distribution from the number of sampled kernels. Experiments on the UCR classification collection ex

translated_title: 预设参数卷积核的机制性解释
translated_abstract: 预设参数卷积变换仅使用固定核、简单池化操作和线性分类器即可实现强大的时间序列分类性能。其成功引发了一个机制性问题：这种表示的哪些性质使该构造有效？我们研究了正值比例（PPV），这是ROCKET、MiniROCKET和MultiROCKET共享的一种池化算子。我们在周期边界条件下建立了PPV对循环平移的精确不变性，并量化了在有限边界下偏离不变性的程度。作为补充分析，我们对平滑PPV替代物的敏感性进行了界定。随后，我们定义了由卷积参数分布所诱导的总体成对几何结构，并展示了有限随机核库如何在该几何结构周围聚集，从而将参数分布的作用与采样核的数量分离开来。在UCR分类数据集上的实验……
tldr: 本文从机制上解释了ROCKET等预设参数卷积方法在时间序列分类中有效的原因：证明其PPV池化特征在周期边界下对平移具有精确不变性，并揭示了有限随机核库会聚集在由参数分布决定的成对几何结构周围。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a mechanistic explanation for why prescribed-parameter convolutional methods (e.g., ROCKET) succeed in time series classification, proving exact translation invariance of PPV pooling under periodic boundaries and showing that finite random kernel banks concentrate around the pairwise geometry induced by the parameter distribution.
